entry.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v0.8.0r2
entry.content:
### Changes - Add a proper Archipelago markdown guide to the docs. [Read this if you want to learn about randomization for this APWorld](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/en_Crypt_of_the_NecroDancer.md). - Add already established option groups property to CotNDWeb like it should have been in the first place. - This allows for option groups to appear in Options Creator instead of the unorganized mess it was previously. - Add display name to `starting_inventory` option. - Fix issue related to All Zones speedrun times setting defaults showing up as `1` for each character in Options Creator. Changed the default to `-1` now to represent being disabled. - [This issue was caused by Options Creator handling OptionCounter `0` values as falsy](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/6221). - If values are manually set to `0`, this is also treated as disabled. Any value less than `3` and greater than `0` are still set to `3` default. I understand 3 minutes is an absurd standard for completing an All Zones Mode run, but for now, if a player sets their speedrun timers to an unrealistic standard, that's on the player. If this turns out to be more of a problem in the future, logic can be added to set minimum speedrun timers for each character as opposed to a uniform 3 minutes. - Fix options descriptions to be more accurate and consistent with each other.
Please see the [setup file](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/setup_en.md) for getting started.
Please inform me of any issues through the associated [Crypt of the NecroDancer channel in the Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1192775219740422176) or through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/issues).

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.6.0
entry.content:
**Win targets recalibrated against a real session.** A 5.5-hour Hard game showed three of the six goals finishing on time and three that never could.
- **The profit goal is yearly now.** The old check read a single `old_economy` entry and called it monthly — those entries are quarters, so the label was wrong twice over. The engine sums the last four completed quarters and the status window says *Yr. Profit*. - **The population goal respects the map.** The engine clamps it to 10,000 per town on the actual map, so a 30-town map is held to 300k, not 700k. This applies to running seeds too. - **Preset table rescaled** (apworld 2.6.0): population 50k–800k across the difficulties, cargo 1.5M–35M (measured throughput was about 1.2M tonnes an hour; the old Hard column was sixty hours of hauling), profit 1M–50M yearly. Company value, vehicles and missions are unchanged.
**Fixed: "Buy any item from the shop" never completed.** The apworld sends that mission as type `purchase`; the engine matched three older strings and none of them was that. The check now also counts shop locations already sent to the server, so purchases made before this fix complete the mission on the next session.
Existing seeds keep their baked cargo and value numbers; the profit unit and the population clamp apply to them immediately. New seeds need apworld 2.6.0. Plugin 1.5.1 only updates the settings form (the profit slider says Yearly); existing YAML files stay valid.

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.0a6
entry.content:
This is an unstable prerelease for players who want to help test CTR Archipelago 0.2.0. It is not the finished stable release. If you prefer the established build, remain on v0.1.5.
**[Setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr)** · **[Alpha6 YAML Builder](https://ap-pie.com/apworlds?build=ctr&version=0.2.0-alpha6)** · **[SETUP.md as shipped](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/v0.2.0-alpha6/SETUP.md)**
Always use the Alpha6 client and APWorld together. Back up an existing Adventure save before testing. CTR-AP requires game data created from your own NTSC-U Crash Team Racing disc; no game or custom-track data is included.
## Alpha6 highlights
- Held 1st, 3rd and 5th checks now rearm for each real race attempt. Restarting, leaving an unfinished race or moving to another track no longer carries the previous race's best position forward and suppresses later checks. - The experimental Custom Content manager verifies the one recognized Alpha6 preview package and can guide players to its creator-provided download. Installing content does not opt a seed into using it. - Baby T Park can be used as an experimental seven-lap Adventure Trophy race replacing Purple Gem Cup. It has stable custom Trophy, podium and Reach 10 Wumpa identities, plus truthful scouted reward presentation. - Recorded AI lap validation rejects recordings whose start and finish boundary is open, preventing the visible finish-line jump seen in earlier preview data. - Cancel at Adventure name entry returns to the title in the Archipelago-owned flow. - Startup connection attempts stop after a small bounded retry budget. Manual Connect retries immediately, while an established session still recovers in the background. - Checks earned while disconnected are retained and sent after reconnecting to the same seed and slot.
Alpha6 also contains the broader 0.2.0 preview work: AP item-box locations, Itemsanity, Lettersanity, character unlocks and racer-locked pads, Progressive Boost and Stats, randomized Gem Cup legs, composable goals, Wumpa progression, expanded presentation and recovery improvements.
## Experimental custom-content boundary
Custom content is off unless the generated seed explicitly selects it. Open Options > Custom Content to inspect the recognized package and export the Alpha6 YAML fragment. The manager fails closed if required files, hashes or capabilities do not match.
Alpha6 supports one curated Baby T Park package for one Adventure Trophy-race shape. General custom-track libraries, Arcade, Time Trial, multiplayer, custom Cups, letters, relic challenges and arbitrary package pools are future work.
## Known limitations
- This is an Alpha test build. The custom-content preview and its manager need broader community testing before stable 0.2.0. - Only NTSC-U game data is supported. PAL and Japanese discs are detected and refused. - A raw MODE2/2352 `.bin` or supported `.chd` is required. Cooked 2048-byte ISO files omit data the client needs. - The public package does not include Baby T Park or any other custom-track bytes. The manager points to the creator's source for the recognized preview package. - Community recorded-AI files are optional and are not bundled. Without them, ordinary engine AI remains available.
## Reporting problems
Run `support-bundle.bat` on Windows or `support-bundle.sh` on Linux after a crash or stuck seed. Attach the resulting archive, your platform, seed or YAML, and a short description to the [CTR-AP issue tracker](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues) or the Crash Team Racing channel in the Archipelago Discord.
## Downloads and verification
Choose one client archive:
- Windows x86: `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.0-alpha6-windows-x86.zip` SHA-256: `ef70315ac2dd8d588eeed91930c3967901dca1cf5a236531847718be415a1d26` - Linux/Steam Deck x86: `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.0-alpha6-linux-x86.tar.gz` SHA-256: `23873cca784df1a0d85824b1e340ba30e9e482e8bc301bf175369f629a736ca2`
Room generators also need the standalone `ctr.apworld`: SHA-256: `4a2fa41e0095f7b8b3514c412931010f19a01afe14cb46b8b0c183bb0aa2dedf`
The release also includes a generated `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml`, checksum sidecars for every archive and symbol file, and separate Windows/Linux debug-symbol assets for crash analysis. The archives contain their own `MANIFEST.sha256` for verifying extracted files.
Release verification completed against the exact paired source heads: 1,374 apworld tests with one skip, 14,000 successful fuzz generations across ten configurations, clean Windows AP/vanilla and Linux AP builds, and 13 of 13 native seed-verifier profiles reporting `seed OK` and `solo: definitive`.
## What's next
After Alpha6, the 0.2.0 line moves into release-candidate stabilization. General multi-package custom tracks, a full Arcade library and broader custom modes remain post-0.2.0 work.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.6.0r2
entry.content:
Engine-only release — the apworld (2.6.0) and plugin (1.5.1) are unchanged from v2.2.1 and are re-attached here so `latest` stays complete.
**The shop** - Bought items sink to the bottom; the list opens on what can still be bought instead of a green wall of past purchases. - Slots unlock in batches of ten, the first ten are free, and a batch costs its tier number in mission credits (1, 2, 3, ... capped at 100). The far end of a 400-slot shop cost about 400 completed missions before; now 39.
**The task board** - Ten active tasks instead of five, and expired tasks vanish and are replaced instead of blocking their slot for a year. - Tasks are only offered on industries that actually produced last month, with amounts that fit inside half their output over the deadline — no more 8,000-tonne pickups from a bank, or goods from a factory nobody supplies. - Passenger tasks pick towns big enough to carry them, and a task counts only the cargo its text names. - Note the engine's own rule: pickup is credited when the cargo is finally delivered, not when it is loaded.

entry.title: Pokepelago v0.6.4
entry.content:
# Pokepelago v0.6.4
In this release, I've brought everything that was on beta during July and August to everyone.
## Web client
- **Sprite fix:** silhouettes no longer stop rendering after switching between Derpy and normal sprites, so you no longer need to refresh the page. (BUG-21) - **New-player onboarding:** I added a first-run "What is Pokepelago?" card and a guided tour of the interface. You can replay it from Settings. - **Tracker fix:** the Pokedex and Pokegear items were swapped in the tracker display, so a granted Pokedex appeared as a Pokegear and vice versa. This was display-only, and seeds were never affected. (BUG-24) - **Sound notifications**, contributed by AfiliaFrostfang: you can opt in to sounds for when a Pokemon becomes guessable and when a progressive item arrives, with support for custom sound files. - **Connection help:** the connect form now explains why an HTTPS page can only reach wss:// servers. - **Decode hardening:** route key and line unlock items now decode using explicit ID maps exported by the APWorld. This replaces client-side arithmetic that has caused drift bugs in the past. - I added search-engine metadata so the site can be found. - The client now reports a few anonymous operational events, including connection successes or failures and goal completions, so I can see recurring problems. There is no account linkage and no gameplay data. Details are at https://ap-pie.com/privacy.
## APWorld
- I fixed a rare generation failure (FillError) that happened when a random region roll landed on Hisui alone with a heavy lock stack. About 0.04% of random-region seeds were affected. - Generation now warns you when route locks or line locks force dexsanity on, instead of silently changing your YAML's setting. - Choosing Hisui as your only region together with two or more lock options is now rejected at the start of generation with a clear message naming the fix, instead of failing later with a cryptic FillError. - I added item name groups for YAML convenience. - Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer is required, unchanged since v0.6.1.
## Also
Pokepelago is now also available at https://pokepelago.ap-pie.com. It is the same site. Just note that your browser's progress and settings stay with whichever address you use.

entry.title: Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII v0.5.1
entry.content:
# Changelog - Added train pass items to unlock Wildlands, Yusnaan, Dead Dunes. An option to start with these has also been added - Changed Mystery Egg to now unlock Ultimate Lair access - Removed being able to access Ultimate Lair from the Ark, now must be reached from the Dead Dunes cactuar teleport - Added Max EP, Max ATB, Item Capacity items into the pool - Added Bhakti's Oil and Bhakti's rewards as items/locations - The Things She Lost quest now requires either the Red or Green Carbuncle Doll logically - Last One Standing quest is now completable. Does not require the Final Day omegas anymore - Luka's Tear quest can be completed all in one day - Soul Seeds are now given from the Loupe, replacing the junk medal items that used to be there - Pilgrim's Cruxes moved down to Useful
# Notes - If you are upgrading Nova Chrysalia mod manager from 1.X to 2.X, uninstall all mods from Nova 1.X first, extract Nova 2.X to a new location, and install all your previous mods in Nova 2.X. - EN Text is required. Text for other languages is not supported due to maintainability concerns with the duplicated data.
# Known Issues/Limits - Items sent to you are retrieved by holding the sprint button on the field (L2/R2 or LT/RT). This is a workaround to avoid crashes when trying to add automatically with no input. - Game overs are removed so you can technically get to the final day without completing the 5 main quests. This is safer for AP, but obviously that would be out of logic by skipping everything. - Recovery items received from AP while your recovery item bag is full will be lost
# Troubleshooting - Do NOT use the File > Reboot option in game, always close the game and relaunch through Nova - In Nova, always launch the game in Unpacked mode with "Voice Over Setting" set to the language you unpacked data for.
If you still have issues without not seeing modded content: 1. Delete unpacked game data in Nova 2. Unpack game data again in Nova 3. Regenerate the rando modpack 4. Uninstall and remove the old modpack in Nova, and re-install the modpack 5. Be sure to launch the game in Unpacked and in the same voice language as unpacked data (EN/JP)!
# Setup Guide:
Download the following:
- lrff13.apworld - LRRandomizer#.#.#.#.7z - [Nova Chrysalia mod manager v2.0.3](https://mega.nz/file/24gyiB7b#nTIlktJb8ZCo8dXZDxCgwsdHAUDPURQhixSfucypIVg)
### AP World and Seed Setup 1. Double click the lrff13.apworld to install the custom world 6. Run the Archipelago Launcher (ArchipelagoLauncher.exe) 7. Click `Generate Template Options` to open the folder with the template yaml files 8. Copy the `Lightning Returns Final Fantasy XIII.yaml` template to the `Players` folder 9. Open your YAML file and edit the `name: Player{number}` to set your name. `{number}` is needed if there will others in the seed with a similar name, you can remove it otherwise. Modify any other options you want below. 10. If hosting: Run the Archipelago Launcher (ArchipelagoLauncher.exe) 11. Click `Generate` 12. Go the `output` folder, and you will find your created `AP_#####.zip` file. 13. To host the game, upload `AP_#####.zip` to: https://archipelago.gg/uploads
### Randomizer Seed Setup
1. Extract the Nova Chrysalia.7z to a folder of your choosing (using Windows, 7zip, etc). 2. Run Nova Chrysalia for the first time and select under Global Installation: "Unpack Game Data (EN Audio)" or "Unpack Game Data (JP Audio)" for the language audio you prefer - Note: You may need to launch LR normally from Steam first 4. Once the AP room is created, click the "Download Patch File" link to download a .aplrff13 mod file. 5. Extract `LRRandomizer#.#.#.#.7z` to a folder of your choosing. 6. Open the extracted folder and run LRRando.exe 7. On the `1. Setup` page and at the top, setup the paths to your Steam LR FFXIII folder and Nova. 8. At the bottom of the `1. entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r2
entry.content:
The first major release is here! The main additions are adding Wondersanity options (both world and national separately) and spawning Great People when GPsanity is on. In particular I'd appreciate testing of the Wondersanity stuff, as it's hard to conclusively test that.
### Changelog: - Two separate Wondersanity options add World Wonders and/or National Wonders into the location pool. Building the wonder sends a location check, and you can build the wonder even if it's obsolete (though you won't get any benefits other than the culture). - Great People are added to the itempool when GPsanity is enabled. The total number of added great people is half the GPsanity number rounded up per type (so at the default of 3 checks, 2 of each GP type are added). These aren't progression (just useful), so it doesn't fully solve the large check number possibility, but it should help a lot, especially at lower numbers. - You can't receive technologies from goody huts or normal GP bulbs if Techsanity is enabled.
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

Finish the seed you're playing on the version that generated it and then upgrade. --- ## Something Broke? entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.1.0r2
entry.content:
# v2.1.0: Various Misc. Things *Intended for use with game mod version 14 (see attachments).*
v2.1.0 contains a handful of new settings, tweaks, and fixes without any particular theming. It's mostly stuff that came up during or shortly after development of v2.0.0 that were either low priority or I otherwise didn't manage to get into an update until now.
⚠ Even if you downloaded the v2.1.0 prerelease, please update your .apworld file with the version here. A logic adjustment and some minor client bugfixes were added to this full version of v2.1.0 that you will miss out on if you don't install the new .apworld below. The game mod is unchanged and can be ignore if you already have version 14.0 of it. ⚠
### Additions/Expansions - New `automatic` setting to `boss_lair_forcing` which forces all goal boss to have collectively the highest cost(s). - Expanded location groups to include per-level and per-realm groups, as well as adding a "Starter Checks" group. - `movement_randomization` now allows for individual randomization of each ability, instead of being all or nothing. - Renamed `starting_breath` -> `starting_breaths` to reflect it now allowing for starting with multiple breaths. Can still start with none or with a random breath, if the list is left empty. - Random breath does **not** require `auto_corrections` to be set to 'fix'. `starting_realms` was adjusted to be similar in not requiring `auto_corrections` anymore to get a random realm chosen.
### Fixes - Fixed `vanilla_minigame_rewards` not working for turret minigames. - Fixed a missing glide requirement in Dragonfly Falls connecting the end of the level back to the start. - Improved error handling in `/check_goal` command.
### Tweaks - Removed glide requirement from the locked chest in the entry area of Dragonfly Falls, as it can be reached from below with just Double Jump quite easily. Similarly adjusted the gem access rule for the Crocovile next to it. - "Generics" filler item selection process is improved to be more uniform. Each one will be picked once before any are doubled up, and similar as more are picked.
